pm.seasoning: 5 dummy wafers run after the clean

claims.statement: PM-612 on DEP01-B was wet clean with wall buildup removed and showerhead new, 5 dummy seasoning wafers run, duration 6.4 h, pre-PM time 61.91 s vs baseline 60.0 s for clean chamber, target 500.0 A with control 493.0 to 507.0 A and spec 485.0 to 515.0 A

History shows mean thickness 504.01 A and prior wet clean with showerhead replaced new and 5 dummy wafers gave 0.21 A first vs later and slope -0.87 A per lot, prior wet clean with 5 dummy wafers gave -0.5 A and slope -0.04 A per lot, prior wet clean skipped gave -7.29 A and slope -0.05 A per lot
Metrology match on 500.0 A certified wafer 2.7 h ago: MET01 reads 499.93 A and MET02 reads 500.05 A, MET02 minus MET01 0.12 A
Monitor 1 run 1 at 60.0 s on MET02 measured 506.8 A implying 8.4467 A per s, 3 wafers left
Monitor 2 run 2 at 59.2 s on MET02 measured 499.48 A implying 8.4372 A per s, 2 wafers left
Estimate using monitors 1 and 2 with MET02 offset 0.05 A gives rate 8.4411 A per s and recipe 59.23 s for 500 A, change -4.32 percent vs pre-PM, pre-PM time would give 522.59 A

release.summary: Wet clean removed buildup so old 61.91 s would run thick. Two monitors after 5 seasoning dummies confirm settled rate after small MET02 correction. New showerhead history shows fast thinning about 0.87 A per lot, so compensate and start at 59.23 s near target with standard EWMA 0.3 for stable control.
